items.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: everyone except for Jimmy Garrison, because he had passed on before I got there.

ctx.x: What was it like playing with Elvin Jones?

Great. I mean John Coltrane was one of my biggest influences, and to be able to have worked with everyone that was in that great band. And I did, everyone except for Jimmy Garrison, because he had passed on before I got there. But I’m working with McCoy Tyner today. I mean in fact I have a tour with him this summer, a summer tour. And I’m scheduled to go to Las Vegas with him next month. And I’ve gone to Japan with him and I’ve recorded with him. So I still work with McCoy on and off. And Elvin Jones, I was some…
Those of us who don’t know him, when you watch him, you get the impression that this could be a mean person.
